user.title: Powerquartier login
user.description: Credentials for burgenland.powerquartier.at. Unofficial integration: reads the same data as the web portal.

profiles.title: Choose profiles
profiles.description: {count} profiles found. Selected profiles are imported hourly as long-term statistics (powerquartier:PROFILE_gemeinschaft / _netz).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Login for {email} failed. Enter the current password.

data_description.days_back: Preliminary values get corrected later by the grid operator; 30 days covers that.

refresh.name: Refresh data
refresh.description: Re-imports the last N days from the portal (hourly). E.g. 700 days reloads the whole history hourly.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days up to yesterday.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Only this profile (short name, e.g. profil_a). Empty = all.
